name: validateInputWithNegativeDurationThrowsException
expected: Throws an exception via Reporter because durationMillis is less than zero (violates timer duration rules).

name: validateInputWithMinNegativeDurationThrowsException
expected: Throws an exception via Reporter because Long.MIN_VALUE is strictly less than zero.

name: constructorWithNegativeDurationThrowsException
expected: Calls validateInput and throws an exception via Reporter when initializing Timer with a negative duration.

name: validateInputWithZeroDurationSucceeds
expected: Does not throw an exception because durationMillis is not less than zero (boundary value).

name: validateInputWithPositiveDurationSucceeds
expected: Does not throw an exception because durationMillis is strictly greater than zero (normal input).

name: validateInputWithMaxLongDurationSucceeds
expected: Does not throw an exception because durationMillis is positive (upper boundary value).

name: constructorWithZeroDurationSucceeds
expected: Successfully constructs the Timer instance without throwing any exceptions.

name: constructorWithPositiveDurationSucceeds
expected: Successfully constructs the Timer instance and properly sets the durationMillis field.

name: constructorWithMaxLongDurationSucceeds
expected: Successfully constructs the Timer instance with the maximum possible long duration value.
